annotations.title: Draft a message to a lead

description: Write a first message for one lead, in the tone set on its campaign: either a private message to the author or a public reply under the post. Returns the text and a link that opens the right place to send it (with the text filled in where the platform allows). Nothing is sent: the user sends it themselves. Each draft counts toward the reply drafts in the user's EvenLeads plan.

lead_id.description: The id of a lead in the user's account.

type.description: direct_message (private, default) or comment (public reply under the post).

name: draft_reply

prefilled.description: True when the link opens with the text already filled in.

template.description: The link with __TEXT__ in place of the URL-encoded message, when prefilled.

title: Draft a message to a lead
